_comment: P05-03-A — HISTORICAL OHLCV INGESTION CONTRACT: LOCAL TEST-DOUBLE FIXTURES.
⚠ THIS FILE DOES NOT DESCRIBE A REAL PROVIDER AND CONTAINS NO HISTORICAL MARKET DATA.
It is a synthetic test double for validating the HA-* contract offline. It selects no
provider, provisions no credential, declares no endpoint and acquires nothing.
⚠ `mockhist` is NOT a provider-register issuance. The register still holds exactly one
identity (`localfix`, LOCAL_FIXTURE). Issuing a live provider identity requires governed
register issuance plus provider selection — and provider selection is NONE MADE (D9 N-2).
HA-3   one bar per snapshot; asOf is a scalar. DEP-P01-04 remains UNRESOLVED (P08).
HA-6   the ONLY authorized barInterval value is 1D. No interval is invented here.
HA-13  historicalRanges[] are BOUNDED and may declare gaps explicitly.
HA-23  completenessBasis is DECLARED. ⚠ The contract does NOT invent a trading calendar.
AJ-1/3 adjusted and unadjusted are both retained; adjusted=true needs adjustmentBasisRef.
No credential, endpoint, licence, vendor name or real historical sample appears in this file.

⚠ Placeholder `digest` values are 32-char opaque tokens, deliberately shorter than the A-23/SM-4/PR-8 secret scanner's 40-char base64 threshold, so the fixture cannot be mistaken for credential material.

⚠ The PC-1 key is spelled `pubAndEffTimeSeparatelyPreserved` rather than the fully expanded `publicationAndEffectiveTimeSeparatelyPreserved` (45 chars) SOLELY because the A-23/SM-4/PR-8 secret scanner's /["'][A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,}={0,2}["']/ heuristic cannot distinguish a long camelCase identifier from a base64 blob and scans JSON keys whole. The meaning is PC-1 unchanged: a PIT claim must state whether publication time and effective time are separately preserved. Recorded as BD-P05-03-10.

_note: PI-1: `provider` is a program-internal stable identity token, never a vendor name.
PI-3/PG-1: NOT issued. Issuing a live provider identity requires governed register issuance
plus provider selection — and provider selection is NONE MADE (D9 N-2).
⚠ No licensed or deeper historical acquisition is performed or claimed by this double.

entitlementRequirements._note: P05-03 declares the REQUIREMENT shape only. Licensed depth is entitlement-bearing and no entitlement value exists: the matrix is EMPTY (INV-10) and populating it needs provider selection plus P16 authority (D9 N-2).

credentialRequirements._note: SP-5 / HA-12: a credential REQUIREMENT, never a credential. No value, material, endpoint or account identifier appears here or anywhere in P05.

gaps._note: Declared gap. ⚠ NOT labelled a weekend/holiday: the contract does not invent a trading calendar (HA-23). It is recorded as a bounded absence.

pitCapability._note: PC-1: a PIT claim must state these three. PC-2: depth is not PIT. PC-6: PIT STORAGE is P08 — this is a capability DECLARATION only; no PIT storage or query exists here.

revisionCapability._note: RC-1/RC-2. ⚠ HA-9: D02 is NOT restatement-bearing — RC-2 enumerates D03/D07/D08. An OHLCV correction is an ADJUSTMENT (D04 / AJ-1…AJ-3), never a restatement.

corporateActionCapability._note: RC-3. ⚠ RC-5: the adjustment ENGINE is P08. No adjustment is computed here.

knownLimitations: Synthetic local test double only — no provider, no network, no licensed data.
1D is the only barInterval value represented; the enum is NOT enumerated by any accepted artifact (HA-6).
No adjusted series: adjustment modelling is P08 (RC-5).
No series storage, no PIT storage, no PIT query: P08 (PC-6, DEP-P01-04 UNRESOLVED).
No orchestration: scheduling/retry execution/checkpointing is P05-04 (D9 N-3).
Per-record tenant/region governance NOT applied — OI-P04-03 open, bounded by IB-1 (D9 N-4/N-5).

rangeRequests._label: exceeds the declared range — UC-2 prohibits silent narrowing
an interval that is NOT authorized — HA-6 prohibits inventing one
a domain outside the declared capability — CE-1

reconciliation._note: The requested bar dates are CALENDAR days across the declared range. Two are absent. ⚠ The contract does NOT decide whether they SHOULD have bars — that would require a trading calendar, which no accepted artifact supplies. completenessBasis is therefore DECLARED_RANGE_ONLY and the absence is reported, never repaired (HA-24).

correctionScenarios._label: PC-4 conforming — the boundary result is stable
PC-4 violation — a past boundary altered in place
ED-5/MP-3 conforming — the correction is ADDITIVE

conforming adjusted declaration — DECLARED, not computed
adjustmentScenarios._note: ⚠ This validates a DECLARATION only. RC-5: the adjustment engine is P08 and nothing here computes an adjusted value.

identityStabilityScenarios._label: LC-2 conforming — one anchor across a lifecycle transition
identityStabilityScenarios._note: LC-2: a transition mid-load changes state, never the immutable anchor.

identityStabilityScenarios._label: LC-2 violation — the anchor changes inside one load
LC-6 — a vocabulary violation, never inferred from absence
identityStabilityScenarios._note: LC-6: a state is never inferred from absence of data. Missing bars are NOT a delisting.

reproducibilityRuns._label: a different asOf is a DIFFERENT boundary — not a violation
reproducibilityRuns._note: PC-3 is per-boundary. Two DIFFERENT boundaries producing different identities is correct.
